test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given pie-charts show the distribution of Graduate and Post-graduate level students in five different colleges A, B, C, D and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb0e0fe92614751237691d044f626c495c1a810d11033c6a4a736041c3766c83.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37be1abb8da4debc3cafbe82d2eab1e83e8dae7c813dbc7624345707f6c46230.png] 

What is the ratio between the number of students studying at Post-Graduate and Graduate levels, respectively, from college E?
solution:
**Solution:**

According to the question, 

16800 × 22/100 : 18900 × 20/100

⇒ 88 : 90

⇒ 44 : 45

**∴ The ratio between the number of students studying at Post-Graduate and Graduate levels, respectively, from college E is 44 : 45.**
